clues: This city sits on the north coast of California. It lies on a bay, far north of San Francisco.
The sea close by keeps its weather mild, with small shifts in heat. Its winters are rainy, its summers dry, and inland summers are much hotter.
Long ago, this port served hundreds of lumber mills near by. It played a top role in the West Coast lumber trade.
This city is home to the oldest zoo in all of California. That fun fact makes animal fans want to see it for themselves.
Its best known sight is the Carson Mansion, a grand old Victorian home. It is known all across the country.
